scope: Internal ML registry; it does not change the HTTP API contract.

status_definitions.candidate: Relevant entry point known; required 2025 archive not yet obtained and validated.
status_definitions.available: A sample for the required period has been obtained and validated.
status_definitions.integrated: A reproducible feature join exists and preserves row cardinality.
status_definitions.validated: Compared on fixed temporal folds; this does not imply improvement.
status_definitions.rejected: Checked variant excluded from selected model for the recorded reason.
status_definitions.blocked: Adequate history, access, license, coverage or geographic link is unconfirmed.

information_modes.operational: Only information available by as_of may be used.
information_modes.competition_retro: Later-published external factors allowed by the contest clarification may be used; future target y remains forbidden.

factors.name: Production calendar
factors.implementation: Verified 2025 days off, transfers, working weekend, adjacent-day flags and day-off streak; date join is many-to-one.

factors.name: Weather and hazardous-condition proxies
factors.implementation: Hourly ERA5 reanalysis at one Moscow grid point; all-null snow_depth excluded without imputation; strict timestamp join.
factors.blocker: Operational mode remains unimplemented because no matching as-of forecast-run archive was used.
